svg.title: B01 / Spice Street west shop row
svg.text: B01 / Spice Street west shop row
Three spice tenancies and two closed household/store access doors form one mixed-use block, with five aligned upper shutters.
Source shells / roofs; rust = design extent, not a live transform.
/7.00; cap tops8.79 /9.59 /8.19. Replace narrow head, rear tier
and bulkhead. Keep five upper closures and three trades. Household
access stays closed. M03 ties; M07 both-direction views.
Opening shapes are schematic; retained repaired frames are not redesigned. Source roof boxes are a static survey, not a live scene
or clearance pass. Dimensions and relationships: buildings.md; assemblies/export bounds: assets.md.
